**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback cure).**

- **Investigation:** The only "insurance" hits in the document are Net Sales deduction references in Article I (p0101, p0102). Article XVI (Indemnification; Recalls) imposes mutual indemnities and product liability/recall exposure but no coverage covenant, and Article XVIII General Provisions runs 18.1–18.14 with no insurance section.
- **Target level:** Fallback (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber and privacy USD 2,000,000) — the shortest complete cure. Preferred CGL, workers' compensation and certificate elements were deliberately not volunteered.
- **Operative change:** New Section 18.15 inserted after 18.14 (p0796), binding Array (counterparty/supplier) only; all existing text preserved verbatim. Redline validated ok:true including the minimality gate.
